Why Madagascar?

Madagascar is an intriguing statistical outlier in the global measles data set. In 2012–2017, there were fewer than 100 cases per year (stable), but in 2018–2019 cases spiked to over 213,000 — nearly a 1,700% increase. Following this peak, cases declined dramatically to fewer than 100 cases.
